info.scriptSrcText: property numberSpriteList, prevScore, displayScore, fuelBar, damageBar, fuelBarDelay, fuelFlashToggle, displayDamage, damageFlashToggle, damageBarDelay, displayFuel, coconutBarglobal gScore, gDamagePercent, gfuelPercent, gPaused, gCoconutson beginSprite  gScore = 0  prevScore = 0  displayScore = float(0)  sprite(the currentSpriteNum).locZ = 2000  numberSpriteList = []  repeat with i = 1 to 7    numberSpriteList.add(sprite(the currentSpriteNum + i - 1))    sprite(the currentSpriteNum + i - 1).locZ = 2000 + 1  end repeat  fuelBar = sprite(the currentSpriteNum + 9)  sprite(the currentSpriteNum + 10).locZ = 2004  fuelBar.locZ = 2003  coconutBar = sprite(2)  coconutBar.locZ = 2003  damageBar = sprite(the currentSpriteNum + 7)  sprite(the currentSpriteNum + 8).locZ = 2002  damageBar.locZ = 2001  fuelBarDelay = 0  displayFuel = 50  fuelFlashToggle = 1  displayDamage = 100  damageBarDelay = 0  damageFlashToggle = 1endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    if gScore > 9999999 then      gScore = 9999999    end if    displayScore = displayScore + ((gScore - displayScore) * 0.20000000000000001)    calcScore = integer(displayScore)    repeat with i = 7 down to 1      temp = calcScore mod power(10, i - 1)      temp1 = (calcScore - temp) / power(10, i - 1)      calcScore = temp      numberSpriteList[i].member = member(50 + temp1, "Gfx")    end repeat    if gfuelPercent > 100 then      gfuelPercent = 100    end if    displayFuel = displayFuel + ((gfuelPercent - displayFuel) * 0.05)    fuelBar.locH = 512 - (displayFuel / 100.0 * 93)    if displayFuel < 30 then      fuelBarDelay = fuelBarDelay + 1      if fuelBarDelay = 4 then        fuelBarDelay = 0        fuelBar.blend = 55 + (45 * fuelFlashToggle)        if fuelFlashToggle = 1 then          fuelBar.locH = 420        end if        fuelFlashToggle = -fuelFlashToggle        if soundBusy(3) = 0 then          puppetSound(3, member(13, "Sfx"))        end if      end if    else      fuelBar.blend = 100    end if    if gDamagePercent > 100 then      gDamagePercent = 100    end if    displayDamage = displayDamage + ((gDamagePercent - displayDamage) * 0.05)    damageBar.locH = displayDamage / 100.0 * 92    if gDamagePercent > 80 then      damageBarDelay = damageBarDelay + 1      if damageBarDelay = 4 then        damageBarDelay = 0        damageBar.blend = 55 + (45 * damageFlashToggle)        damageFlashToggle = -damageFlashToggle        if soundBusy(3) = 0 then          puppetSound(3, member(13, "Sfx"))        end if      else        damageBar.blend = 100      end if    end if    coconutBar.locH = gCoconuts * 9  end ifend
